The terrible trio of this season's Surrey League, youths and boys: - Peter Carton happy, Bill Curtin a trifle bored, and Tony Binda apparently wondering when the race is going to start. This was was taken at the first race of the season, at Wimbledon in October, but it could equally well have been taken at the second or third.

It's 14th February 1970 and Tony Binda takes over from John Stowe at the start of stage three of the Mitcham Young Athletes Relay in Morden Park.  Belgrave placed 5th.  Tony is still picking up Surrey County medals 28 years later.  How does he look today?  See centre pages

(a) Walton AC's Hewitt-Jones and Surrey Road Relay, 13th September 1997.  Junior Galley (75) takes over from veteran Tony Binda (74).  Junior has left his staff in charge at the record store to help the Bels to a Surrey 'gold'.  Surely Tony would never have dreamed that he'd be back winning Senior Surrey medals again.
